metrics_finding.finding: The CPU utilization of the auth-service increased from 0.00866 to 0.015963333333333333 during the failure window, indicating a potential issue with high CPU usage.

evidence_summary.summary: The CPU utilization of the auth-service increased from 0.00866 to 0.015963333333333333 during the failure window, indicating a potential issue with high CPU usage.

report.suggested_fix: Monitor and adjust the CPU resource allocation for the auth-service.

report_text.en: The root cause of the incident is believed to be a high CPU utilization issue in the auth-service. Monitoring and adjusting the CPU resource allocation may help resolve the issue.
report_text.hi: अप्रत्याशित घटना के मुख्य कारण विश्वसनीयता स्तर 0.8 के साथ यह है कि ऑथेंटिक सेवा में उच्च CPU उपयोग एक समस्या हो सकती है। CPU संसाधनों को ऑथेंटिक सेवा के लिए समायोजित करने से समस्या का समाधान होने की संभावना है।
